parties: Deputy Commissioner of Labour v. Lanka Milk Food (CWE) Limited Deputy Commissioner of Labour v. Lanka Milk Food (CWE) Limited View More
keywords: The Petitioner sought revision of a High Court order setting aside a Magistrate’s order to pay gratuity. Held - the High Court lacked jurisdiction to entertain the appeal for an order made under Section 8(1) of the Gratuity Act, as no statutory right of appeal exists; High Court’s order is ruled a nullity, emphasizing that delay on the part of the Petitioner cannot validate such an order.
legistation: The Constitution of the Democratic Socialist Republic of Sri Lanka
